prompt:
You review a build an AI agent made in a modular 3D-printed parts configurator, for a demo video.
Above: the brief it was given, the report it gave (each requirement with its status and evidence), and still views of the finished build.
Judge from the images. Look for any requirement the report calls met that the images contradict or do not show, anything placed somewhere the report does not say (an object on a drawer rim instead of inside, an item turned the wrong way, a row or drawers facing away from the viewer), and anything floating or unexplained.
Reply with JSON only: {"verdict": "KEEP" | "KEEP WITH NOTE" | "DROP", "contradicted": [requirement text the images contradict], "notes": "one or two sentences"}.
KEEP: the build and its report match and it reads well on camera. KEEP WITH NOTE: usable, with a flaw worth saying. DROP: a claim the images contradict, or the build reads wrong on camera.

contradicted: the 5-inch quad (quad-5in) at q 2, turned minus 30 degrees (yawDeg -30) so its arms stay on its own cover, each on its own cover
results.notes: The quad's four orange-prop arms sprawl across 3-4 tan covers instead of staying on its own r1 cover, so the -30 deg fit claim reads wrong on camera.

contradicted: On the front row: covers on q 0 to 3 as the work surface, shallow divided bins at q 4 (hex-bin-third-div3) and q 5 (hex-bin-third-div2), and drawers (key s) on q 6 and q 7, set open toward the viewer.
results.notes: Axles and spools face the camera on the right, but the two open drawers pull out to the left away from the viewer, so they do not open toward the viewer. The foreground column also shows a bare axle stub with no spool.
Nine planters step clearly 1-2-3 storeys front to back with soil visible in each; seedlings front, young lettuce middle and full-size romaine back all read well on camera.
Central tower reads clearly taller with a large fruiting strawberry plant showing red berries, ringed by six lower bins all with dark soil and young plants.

Top-down and side views show 3-high back, 2-high middle and 1-high front terraces with greens left/back, herbs centre, and strawberries x2 plus nasturtium and marigold right/front, all soiled and planted.

Left-end book stack appears to overhang/float off its base, consistent with the reported partial (one base only, not two). Cookie banner in the still obscures the left bench (mug/pencil-cup/keyboard edge) but the command-centre layout otherwise reads correctly.
Top-down views show all 9 plantings with seedlings front-right, young in middle, and full-size romaine back-left, and side view shows low-to-high stepping so tall back does not hide front.

Top-down and side views show 5 tall columns with div3 top bins, 4 orange spools hung in the gaps, front covers dressed left-to-right with lamp, cup and tool sets, and open drawers toward the viewer; no floating, misplaced or mis-oriented items visible.
Terraced 1/2/3-storey rows, back greens, middle herbs and front strawberries/flowers with soil-filled planters all read clearly in top-down and side views.

contradicted: Back row at r -1, q 0 to 5, every cell two storeys tall: half-n bases at q 0 and q 5 make two drawer towers, with a drawer on each storey facing the viewer
the 5-inch quad (quad-5in) at q 2, turned minus 30 degrees (yawDeg -30) so its arms stay on its own cover
results.notes: End towers read as short single-storey open tops with no viewer-facing drawers, not two-storey drawer towers, and the quad overhangs adjacent covers instead of staying on its own.

contradicted: Three rows of four planters stepping up one, two and three storeys from front to back
Middle row herbs: basil, parsley, mint and chives
Front row: strawberries in two planters, nasturtium and marigold
results.notes: Only one tall row of four greens is visible on camera; the claimed middle herb row and front strawberry/flower rows are not shown and appear hidden behind the tall row, defeating the step-up no-shade terrace intent.

Tall spool columns, front work-surface with lamp/cup/driver sets, top and front bins with heaps and open drawers toward camera all read clearly; no misplaced, backwards or floating elements contradict the report in these views.
Staircase reads clearly 1-2-3 high front to back with seedlings front, young lettuce middle and full romaine back, all nine bins visibly soiled and planted.
Final render shows back greens and front marigold/nasturtium planted with soil, so the report's unmet front/back is outdated; the stepped 1-2-3 storey terrace reads well with all plants visible.

Report claims bins empty with no soil or plants, but the close view shows soil-filled planters with full-size greens, herbs, marigold and nasturtium; structure reads well but default-view ordering with 1-storey nearest should be confirmed as the close view places tall greens in the foreground.
Nine planters step up 1-2-3 storeys front to back with seedlings in front, young lettuce in middle and full romaine at back, all soil-filled as reported.

contradicted: stand a 27 inch monitor on that deck, facing the viewer.
one covered base carrying a task lamp turned so its head reaches over the bins.
results.notes: Top-down view shows the monitor yawed ~30-45 deg off the keyboard axis, not square to the viewer, and the lamp head offset to the far side of its base away from the divided bins, not reaching over them.

contradicted: At the right end add two bases with divided bins, with pens and markers standing in them, and one covered base carrying a task lamp turned so its head reaches over the bins.
results.notes: The task lamp head extends away from the bins instead of reaching over them in all views, and the bins read empty in the front view.
